purpose: gnsslad7 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 147): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..6 then NEW step 7 (2 s console pause first): + GP_FUNCTION_EN 0x18001878[0] and the BGF power acks. Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
